description: Fabric 26.2 client mod: press any key to close Hypixel SkyBlock dungeon secret chests, like Esc

mods.name: Secret Chest Quick Close
mods.description: In Hypixel SkyBlock dungeons, any key press closes an open secret chest, just like Esc. Mouse clicks and Shift/Ctrl/Alt are left alone. It never closes anything on its own.

releases.notes:
First release, for Minecraft Java 26.2 (Fabric).

In Hypixel SkyBlock dungeons, a key press closes an open secret chest, the same as Esc. Shift, Ctrl, Alt and mouse clicks are left alone, and it never closes anything on its own.

**Install:** Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API for 26.2, then put `secretchestquickclose-1.0.0.jar` in your `mods` folder. Settings are in the [README](https://github.com/telmuad/secret-chest-quick-close#settings).
